messages:
sasha: DSAR received for user redacted123 asking deletion of chats and uploaded files. Items are in nightly encrypted snapshots (s3://redwood-backups/2026/) encrypted with retired alias redwood-backup-v1.

sasha: Legal flagged an active vuln triage referencing this account. Need guidance on retention exception vs deletion timeline.

mike: If backups are immutable/versioned, deleting live items won't remove snapshots. Rewrap possible but manual; requires old key access.

ada: Legal: place immediate hold if vuln triage may need data. That supersedes deletion until cleared. Open retention-exception ticket and attach verification docs.

ops-oncall: Ops steps: 1) retention.holds.add(redacted123, reason="vuln-triage"); 2) tag snapshots with Hold=VULN_TRIAGE; 3) create ticket to block deletes on held objects.

mike: RBAC: restrict kms:ReEncrypt and s3:GetObject for backup keys to backup-operator+legal-priv via approval workflow. Add audit rule for kms:Decrypt/kms:ReEncrypt capturing principal and request-id.

sasha: Can we redact live PII immediately while preserving snapshots? Prefer to minimize exposure.

ops-oncall: Yes. Run live redaction (maintenance window) and log admin actor, commit, and before_snapshot_ref. Example pseudo: UPDATE messages SET content='[REDACTED] (per DSAR id=redacted123)' WHERE user_id='redacted123';

mike: Ensure redaction logged in audit index with actor, change_hash, ticket_id, before_snapshot_ref.

ada: Legal will continue identity verification. If verification passes and hold is lifted, follow DSAR erase playbook and produce audit package.

legal-bot: retention-exception ticket created: RE-2026-3421 by ada. Linked vuln ticket VULN-2026-128. Hold tags applied.

ops-oncall: Follow-ups: export snapshot object list with user artifacts; seal old-key credentials in vault; schedule rewrap only after legal clearance.

mike: I'll draft RBAC PR and link to RE-2026-3421.

ada: Action items: sasha attach verification docs; ops apply hold and redact live; mike prepare RBAC and audit changes.

sasha: Will attach docs and ping when ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
